speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are early from the yard, Master Shakespeare, or else I have lost the clock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Only for the half hour, mistress. I want the paint off and a dry band. The company sups at the Keys at half past six.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the four young men kept their oath no better than I said they would, and the town paid to see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven pound eleven at the doors. They went out quiet at the end. I am not going to explain it over a basin.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Quiet, from a yard. There is warm water in the copper if you want the sizing off your brow.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Here is the band from the press, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thank you, Alse. I am obliged.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: See you use the key if you are past eight. I am not sitting up for a parlour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the key. I will not ask the house to wait. The letter is still on the desk, and it is not tonight's errand.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have not touched the letter, sir.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Leave the tavern noise in Gracechurch Street, and come back a man who can find his own stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I shall. Seven pound eleven is the sum, and it can stay at the inn until Saturday. This house does not divide it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I should hope not. A sum that large has no business on a bread-board. Was the blue gown in it, since you are telling the house anything at all?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was on Nick. He could turn in it. The fifty shillings are still unpaid. I am not paying them out of an afternoon.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And the ladies, sir. Did they have the better, as you told mistress in January?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They had the better of it. The yard went out quiet. I left the words where I marked them, and I am not going to improve them now, with a wet face.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not improve them in my passage. Dry the face. The band is clean. Half past six is their hour, not mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Their hour. I will be at the table there, and back when the cup is done. If I am past eight, the key is mine.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I leave a candle on the stair?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: One, and it is his own. I am not lighting the house for a supper I am not cooking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One is enough. Thank you. I have the sum, I have the quiet, and I have a band. That is as much as a man should carry out of his own lodging twice in a day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then carry them, and do not bring me a third. Go on.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The band sits straight, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will do. Half past six, and not a word more about the sum until Saturday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Saturday may keep it. This stair is for feet, not for figures. Shut the door behind you.
